name: Araceli E. Ziemba, DMD
what_they_do: Solo-practitioner general and cosmetic family dental practice at 1861 Route 130, with a patient-education library, online patient forms, insurance and financial-policy pages, and an appointment-request form.
customers: Local families and adults; insured patients (dedicated dental-insurance and 'patients without dental insurance' pages) plus online bill-pay users.

size_signals.signal: Practice branded under the dentist's own name with a 'Meet The Team' page - inference: single dentist with hygienist/front-desk staff
Open late two nights a week (Mon and Wed 9am-8pm), 9-5 Tue/Thu, closed Fri-Sun
Listed in 2025/2026 Cigna and Medicare Advantage provider directories and the ADA Find-a-Dentist directory

listing.platform: WebMD / Healthgrades / RateMDs (no Google listing captured)

website_review.primary_cta: Appointment Request form plus phone (732) 297-0588 as a tel: link in the header
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Appointment request form ('Create an Appointment' - scheduling coordinator calls back to confirm); no live calendar
website_review.trust_signals: Patient testimonials page, patient-education library, insurance and financial-policy pages, practice policies (cancellation, minors), online bill pay
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Legacy template design; the appointment form is a third-party lead-form script (smbleads.ibsmb.com) and the page source loads a reCAPTCHA key, i.e. a bot check in front of the form
website_review.search_basics: Page titles include the town and service (e.g. 'Make An Appointment|North Brunswick, NJ-Araceli E. Ziemba, DMD') and there is a proper meta description plus canonical URLs; services have their own section pages
top_issues: The site returned '403 Unauthorized' to a standard Chrome session (tried www and non-www) - it only loaded through a reader proxy, so real visitors and some AI crawlers may be blocked even though robots.txt is fully permissive
Appointment request form appears protected by reCAPTCHA, which blocks an agent from booking end-to-end
No schema.org JSON-LD found in the page source of the pages fetched
Old-school template: no online calendar, no visible reviews, hours only on the appointment/office page

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt is unusually AI-friendly - explicit Allow rules for OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot and others, with only Yandex/Baidu/Bytespider blocked. Hours, services and policies are real text. However the server answered 403 Unauthorized to a normal browser twice, which undercuts 'findable', and no JSON-LD was present in the source checked. Booking is a request form with a reCAPTCHA key loaded, so no agent can complete it.

operations_signals.signal: Appointment requests are manually confirmed ('Our scheduling coordinator will contact you'), so every web request creates a callback task
Dedicated pages for cancellation/broken-appointment policy and minors - inference: broken appointments are enough of a problem to need written policy, a good target for automated reminders
Online bill pay runs through a separate ident.ws portal - inference: payment questions still route to staff

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the 403 blocking so the site loads for all normal visitors and crawlers, then keep the AI-friendly robots.txt working as intended
top_opportunities.evidence: Two browser loads of https://www.drziemba.com/ and https://drziemba.com/ both returned '403 Unauthorized'; content only loaded through a proxy reader

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add Dentist/LocalBusiness JSON-LD (address, hours, phone, services) and replace the request form with real-time booking so agents can answer and book
top_opportunities.evidence: No ld+json found in page source; appointment page requires a form submission and loads reCAPTCHA, with staff confirming afterwards

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated recall and no-show reminders tied to the existing cancellation policy, plus a review-request flow (visible ratings today live on Healthgrades/RateMDs, not on the site)
top_opportunities.evidence: Practice publishes a cancelled/broken appointment policy page; no review content or rating badge appears on the site

scores.reasons: Site architecture and crawl directives are decent but a 403 block, no schema and a CAPTCHA'd request form leave real gaps; solo practice means limited budget; fixes are small and well-scoped; evidence partly indirect because the browser could not render the site for a mobile check.
